scenes.text: Build multiplication facts from known facts. For example, 6 times 7 equals 5 times 7 plus 7, so 35 plus 7 equals 42.
Use the known fact 8 times 9 equals 72 to find 9 times 9. The answer is 81. Add one group of 9: 72 plus 9 equals 81.
A learner at a school fair knows 4 times 5 equals 20. How can they calculate 5 times 5 using one more group? Pause to choose and explain.
